_about: Test data for pick_eval.py, on public domain NASA podcast episodes (Houston We Have a Podcast 393, 378, 370), first 20 minutes each.

These picks were chosen by Claude, the AI that wrote this code, from reading the transcripts before any scorer had run on them. They stand in until you add your own, so they measure agreement with one AI editor's taste, not with a person's.
Download the audio from images-assets.nasa.gov/audio/<id>/<id>~128k.mp3 (Ep393_Crew-11 as ep393.mp3).
